a.title: Someone's attacking a critical 0-day RCE in F5 BIG-IP APM

b.lede: F5 has released security updates to address a critical BIG-IP APM zero-day vulnerability being exploited in remote code execution attacks. [...]
b.title: F5 patches BIG-IP APM zero-day flaw exploited in RCE attacks
